_comment: Non-GitHub automations that automation-status.yml can't introspect (Cowork cloud routines + Mac scheduled tasks). SOURCE OF TRUTH is the Obsidian strategy vault 'Automations.md' — keep this file in sync with it (Cowork owns the vault write; a repo-side agent edits this JSON). GitHub Actions are discovered automatically and must NOT be listed here.

off_github.name: Supabase security advisors sweep
off_github.purpose: Cowork cloud routine that runs Supabase get_advisors (security + performance) against prod and reports new advisories; the DB-side counterpart to the repo security-audit job (weekly-sweep.yml).

off_github.name: Cloud Claude maintenance routines (deps/weekly-*, fix/build-*)
off_github.purpose: Anthropic-side scheduled Claude runs that open dependency-upgrade and build-fix branches (deps/weekly-*, fix/build-*, claude/*) for review; scheduled outside this repo.
